fusions.name: Sounding Howl
fusions.desc: A howl pitched above hearing that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, stuns them for 0.8 seconds and leaves them [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Echo-Marked Bite
fusions.desc: A darting bite that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Roost in Shadow
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 7 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later. The veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Moonless Hunt
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
